meaning: Revelation closes with an invitation to receive the water of life freely. The Spirit, the bride, and those who hear participate in the call. The final note of this reading journey is welcome, rather than a demand to arrive as someone with no remaining thirst.
heart: At the end of these readings, name something you want to keep practicing and someone with whom you might share the journey. You may still have questions and needs. Let a year become an opening for continued relationship, instead of a test you must pass.
holdOn: The journey can continue with room for my questions and thirst.
prayer: God of welcome, thank you for meeting me through these days of Scripture. Help me carry one learned truth into a living practice and receive the care I still need. Keep me curious, connected, and willing to return as the journey continues. Amen.
